intro: Understand the environmental rules on the management of waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE), identify the obligations for separate collection and the exceptions to the municipal service.

palabras.consejo: A feminine noun for technical devices.

palabras.significado: to drop off; to hand in waste
palabras.consejo: A transitive verb from municipal technical language.

texto: La corretta gestione dei rifiuti di apparecchiature elettriche ed elettroniche rappresenta una priorità strategica per il Comune, al fine di incentivare il recupero di materie prime pregiate e prevenire la dispersione di sostanze altamente inquinanti nell'ecosistema urbano. I cittadini residenti possono conferire gratuitamente piccoli dispositivi domestici, batterie esauste e caricabatterie presso l'ecocentro comunale dal lunedì al sabato in orario continuato. Prima della consegna, l'utente è tenuto a rimuovere batterie al litio estraibili e schede di memoria contenenti dati personali riservati; i dispositivi non devono presentare parti visibilmente manomesse o schiacciate. Per il ritiro a domicilio di grandi elettrodomestici, quali frigoriferi, lavatrici o condizionatori, è necessario prenotare il servizio via internet con almeno cinque giorni lavorativi di anticipo, posizionando l'apparecchio sul marciapiede la sera precedente. Il conferimento abusivo di rifiuti speciali sul suolo pubblico è severamente punito con pesanti sanzioni amministrative.

frases.estudio: La gestione dei rifiuti elettronici è fondamentale per recuperare materie prime e proteggere l'ambiente.
frases.alumno: The management of electronic waste is essential for recovering raw materials and protecting the environment.

frases.estudio: I cittadini possono consegnare gratuitamente i piccoli apparecchi e le batterie all'ecocentro.
frases.alumno: Citizens can hand in small appliances and batteries free of charge at the recycling centre.
analisis: can hand in free of charge

frases.estudio: Prima della consegna occorre rimuovere le schede di memoria e le batterie estraibili.
frases.alumno: Before handing them in, you must remove the memory cards and the removable batteries.

frases.estudio: Per i grandi elettrodomestici è previsto il ritiro a domicilio su prenotazione telefonica o digitale.
frases.alumno: For large household appliances, home collection is available, booked by phone or online.

pregunta.texto: What is the double priority aim of the separate collection of electronic waste?

opciones.texto: Recovering valuable raw materials and preventing polluting substances from spreading into the environment
opciones.explicacion: The text stresses environmental protection and the circular economy.

opciones.texto: Making commercial profit by reselling old appliances to neighbouring countries
opciones.explicacion: The collection responds to an environmental recycling directive that is not for profit.

opciones.texto: Replacing all the city's household appliances with analogue models
opciones.explicacion: An absurd purpose unrelated to the goals of the municipal recycling centre.

frase.texto: Prima della consegna occorre ___ le batterie al litio dal dispositivo.

opciones.explicacion: Transitive infinitive governed by the impersonal necessity formula «occorre».
Past participle, which does not fit after the impersonal verb «occorre».
Third-person conjugated form that would break the impersonal structure.

pregunta.texto: What preliminary step is essential before handing in a used electronic device?

opciones.texto: Removing the lithium batteries and taking out the memory cards containing personal data
opciones.explicacion: The regulations require protecting privacy and avoiding short circuits.

opciones.texto: Painting the outer casing with white waterproof paint
opciones.explicacion: No cosmetic treatment is required for unused appliances.

opciones.texto: Presenting a medical certificate of the owner's good health
opciones.explicacion: An unfounded requirement with no link to waste management.

pregunta.texto: How should the municipal collection of large appliances such as washing machines or fridges be arranged?

opciones.texto: Booking the online service five working days ahead and leaving the appliance on the pavement the evening before
opciones.explicacion: Home collection follows a set procedure.

opciones.texto: Throwing the fridge into the communal organic waste bins in the early morning
opciones.explicacion: This is illegal dumping, punishable by severe fines.

opciones.texto: Taking the washing machine on foot to the central town hall offices in person
opciones.explicacion: Large appliances have a booked home collection service.

piezas.traduccion: The recycling centre collects small electronic devices
piezas.explicacion: Put the terms of the citizens' guide in order.

pregunta.texto: What legal consequences does the illegal dumping of special waste on public roads carry?

opciones.texto: The imposition of severe penalties and substantial administrative fines
opciones.explicacion: «È severamente punito con pesanti sanzioni amministrative».

opciones.texto: A formal commendation from the environment department for clearing the home
opciones.explicacion: Abandonment is a gravely disapproved administrative offence.

opciones.texto: Receiving a discount voucher to buy new appliances in department stores
opciones.explicacion: It directly contradicts the penalty regime described.
